description: INV-38, HO-33, 15 §4.8: a launch over the re-homed edges stream still resolves and binds the conversation of its init line. A checkpoint step and a reply that said nothing publish nothing; a tool step with no nameable subject is summarized by its tool name; an unknown event and a line that is not JSON are each skipped and reported once as protocol drift, never thrown; an ERROR result ends the turn errored with the status as its detail (never the error text of the CLI, ADR-026); the half-written last line waits for its end.

cause.detail: an event this build has no reading for
a line that is not JSON
